label: GO after consecutive rewards, early in the episode only
explanation: Fires only at GO, and only when the previous trial was rewarded (no activation at all after an unrewarded trial, nor at D1/D2). It is also strongly tied to time in the episode: active rate ~14-15% of GO steps for trials 0-29, falling through trials 30-50, and essentially silent after ep_trial ~55. Requiring that the trial before that was also not unrewarded (a reward streak; tv=-9 at the window edge counts as allowed) raises precision from 0.58 to 0.72 at dev F1 0.79 / mass recall 0.95; magnitude grows along reward streaks in the examples. Requiring prev_common==1 hurts recall. Model value at GO in [7.7, 8.1] also correlates but adds nothing beyond prev_reward and ep_trial. Remaining false positives are rewarded GO steps early in the episode where the unit stays below threshold. All variables used are observed (the agent can track elapsed time in principle); no future variables.
